## Why This Is Asked

```yaml
apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: Intentions
spec:
  - source:
      namespaces: ["frontend"]
      name: "web-api"
    destination:
      namespaces: ["backend"]
      name: "user-service"
    action: allow
  - source:
      namespaces: ["monitoring"]
      name: "prometheus"
    destination:
      namespaces: ["*"]
      name: "*"
    action: allow
```
